newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA SOFTER, SHORT DEPOS FIRMER, BONDS IDLE.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA SOFTER, SHORT DEPOS FIRMER, BONDS IDLE.

text.p: Greek short-term depos were firmer five to 20 basis points at mid-session, forex forwards were holding Friday levels, ecu/drachma was easier and bonds were idling with London markets closed, dealers said.
"Depos are up five to 20 basis points in short tenors up to three weeks," said a money market trader at a private bank.
Dealers said funding for two-year zeros was mainly responsible for the pick up in short-term rates.
The finance ministry announced on Friday that it raised more than 350 billion drachmas from two-year zeros featuring a gross yiled of 9.9 percent
Forex forwards were little changed and trading activity was subdued with London markets closed.
Traders said bonds were trading narrowly in the absence of incentives with London markets closed.
"There is no incentive for trading with London markets closed," said a bond trader at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 158.89/94 from Friday's 159.270 fix, the dollar at 274.45/55 drachmas from 274.720 and the ecu at 310.00/10 from 310.400 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is easier trading slightly below 310," said a senior private bank trader. "The central bank's move to sell ecus for drachmas on Friday's fixing."
